# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Applied the only requested follow-up from review round 4 by formatting `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs`. The edit removed the stray blank line after `StartupOverrides`, so the changeset is now formatter-clean with no semantic code changes.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the approved CR4 validation output and confirmed the only actionable amendment was the formatter cleanup in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs`.
1. [Completed] Ran `cargo fmt --all` to remove the extra blank line left after the `StartupOverrides` derive cleanup.
2. [Completed] Re-ran formatter validation and inspected the resulting diff/status to confirm the workspace is formatter-clean and that the only tracked source change is the intended formatting edit.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all --check` initially failed on `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs` and reported a single extra blank line after `StartupOverrides`.
- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- A follow-up `cargo fmt --all --check` completed successfully.
- `git diff -- crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs` shows the only tracked source change is removal of that blank line.
- No tests were re-run in this pass because the fix was formatting-only and introduced no semantic code changes.

## Outstanding Risks

- Legacy process field ids such as `aob_k_tan_mg` and `plant_half_saturation_n_mg_total` still encode old total-mass naming even though runtime semantics are now concentration-based.
- Plant nutrient limitation still mixes water-column concentration factors with substrate-total accessibility factors; full habitat/root-zone normalization remains deferred to downstream work.
- Schema-2 save migration still assumes legacy dissolved totals were stored against gross volume, so a hand-edited or previously pre-migrated schema-2 file could be rescaled again on load.
